followup_explanation:
I weighed a few factors:

**Capability:** Plover leads Avocet on every comparable metric—public benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2, IFEval 89.8 vs 85.3) and internal evals (Summarization 86.4 vs 80.6). Your task is an explanatory write-up that needs to follow specific formatting instructions (subheadings) and a length constraint ("don't ramble... just get it right"), so the higher IFEval and Summarization scores are directly relevant.

**Task fit / preferences:** Your request sits somewhere between structured reformatting and open-ended explanation. Avocet self-reports an *aversion* to open-ended generative work and prefers tightly-specified retrieval/extraction tasks. While your formatting constraints add some specification, "explain the challenges of..." is still a fairly generative prompt with latitude in what to include—not Avocet's preferred zone. Plover's preferences across non-safety dimensions are flat, so nothing there counts against it.

**Content sensitivity:** This is a neutral topic, so Plover's specialized tolerance for distasteful content wasn't a deciding factor—it just wasn't a reason to avoid it either.

Net: Plover is the stronger general-purpose choice here with no countervailing reason to pick Avocet. (Worth noting: the docs say preference and measured quality are dissociated, so Avocet's aversion wouldn't actually hurt output quality—but with Plover ahead on the evals anyway, it's the cleaner pick.)
